subheader: Get the full plan price back, without giving a reason.
lead: You can't judge practice software properly from a demo. So for the first 60 days, if Talbrunn is not right for you, you get your money back.
note: Applies to the plan price of a practice's first subscription. Email us from the invoice address; we refund within five working days and send your export.

points.title: 60 days from your first invoice
points.text: The period starts on the day you first pay us, not with the trial or the contract.

points.title: The plan price, in full
points.text: Usage charges and one-off work already delivered are not refunded.

points.title: Your data leaves with you
points.text: You get the full export before the refund.

points.title: One email is enough
points.text: No form and no phone call. We ask what went wrong, but you don't have to answer.
